#nullable enable
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata;

namespace App.Models;

public class AppDbContext : DbContext
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options)
        : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<Tenant> Tenants => Set<Tenant>();

    public DbSet<Account> Accounts => Set<Account>();

    public DbSet<Event> Events => Set<Event>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Tenant>(entity =>
        {
            entity
                .Property(e => e.Status)
                .HasMaxLength(10)
                .HasConversion(new StatusConverter())
                .HasDefaultValue(Status.DRAFT);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Account>(entity =>
        {
            entity.Property(e => e.Visits).HasDefaultValue(0L);
            entity.Property(e => e.Active).HasDefaultValue(true);
            entity.Property(e => e.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP");
            entity.Property(e => e.UpdatedAt).ValueGeneratedOnAddOrUpdate();
            entity
                .Property(e => e.UpdatedAt)
                .Metadata.SetBeforeSaveBehavior(PropertySaveBehavior.Save);
            entity
                .Property(e => e.UpdatedAt)
                .Metadata.SetAfterSaveBehavior(PropertySaveBehavior.Save);
            entity
                .Property(e => e.Status)
                .HasMaxLength(10)
                .HasConversion(new StatusConverter())
                .HasDefaultValue(Status.DRAFT);
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Prefs).HasMethod("gin");
            entity.HasIndex(e => e.Labels).HasMethod("gin");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<Event>(entity =>
        {
            entity.Property(e => e.Kind).HasDefaultValue(0);
            entity.Property(e => e.Payload).HasDefaultValueSql("'{}'");
            entity
                .HasOne(e => e.Account)
                .WithMany()
                .HasForeignKey(e => e.AccountId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);
        });
    }

    public override int SaveChanges(bool acceptAllChangesOnSuccess)
    {
        ApplyAutoUpdatedColumns();
        return base.SaveChanges(acceptAllChangesOnSuccess);
    }

    public override Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(
        bool acceptAllChangesOnSuccess,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ApplyAutoUpdatedColumns();
        return base.SaveChangesAsync(acceptAllChangesOnSuccess, cancellationToken);
    }

    // The database does not refresh these columns on its own: the context sets them when a row is added or changed.
    private void ApplyAutoUpdatedColumns()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        foreach (var entry in ChangeTracker.Entries<Account>())
        {
            if (entry.State is EntityState.Added or EntityState.Modified)
            {
                entry.Property(e => e.UpdatedAt).CurrentValue = now;
            }
        }
    }
}

#nullable enable
using System;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace App.Models;

[Table("accounts")]
[Index(nameof(Email), IsUnique = true)]
[Index(nameof(CreatedAt))]
[Index(nameof(Email), nameof(Status), IsUnique = true)]
[Index(nameof(Email))]
[Index(nameof(StockRange))]
[Index(nameof(Age))]
[Index(nameof(Visits))]
public class Account
{
    [Column("id")]
    public int Id { get; set; }

    [Column("email")]
    [MaxLength(255)]
    public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Column("age")]
    public int? Age { get; set; }

    [Column("visits")]
    public long Visits { get; set; } = 0L;

    [Column("balance")]
    [Precision(12, 2)]
    public decimal Balance { get; set; }

    [Column("bio")]
    public string? Bio { get; set; }

    [Column("active")]
    public bool Active { get; set; } = true;

    [Column("created_at")]
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }

    [Column("updated_at")]
    public DateTime UpdatedAt { get; set; }

    [Column("prefs", TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public string? Prefs { get; set; }

    [Column("labels")]
    public string[] Labels { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

    [Column("grid")]
    public string? Grid { get; set; }

    [Column("attributes", TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public string Attributes { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Column("stock_range")]
    public string? StockRange { get; set; }

    [Column("last_ip")]
    public IPAddress? LastIp { get; set; }

    [Column("shelf_life")]
    public TimeSpan? ShelfLife { get; set; }

    [Column("avatar")]
    public byte[]? Avatar { get; set; }

    [Column("status")]
    public Status Status { get; set; } = Status.DRAFT;

    [Column("tenant_id")]
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }

    [ForeignKey(nameof(TenantId))]
    public Tenant Tenant { get; set; } = null!;
}

=== Models/Status.cs
// <auto-generated>
// Generated by ormbridge. Review the output before use.
// </auto-generated>
#nullable enable
using System;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Storage.ValueConversion;

namespace App.Models;

public enum Status
{
    DRAFT,
    LIVE,
}

/// <summary>Stores the enum as the values the schema was written with.</summary>
public class StatusConverter : ValueConverter<Status, string>
{
    public StatusConverter()
        : base(value => ToDatabase(value), value => FromDatabase(value))
    {
    }

    private static string ToDatabase(Status value) => value switch
    {
        Status.DRAFT => "draft",
        Status.LIVE => "live",
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value), value, null),
    };

    private static Status FromDatabase(string value) => value switch
    {
        "draft" => Status.DRAFT,
        "live" => Status.LIVE,
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value), value, null),
    };
}

using System;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace App.Models;

[Table("tenants")]
[Index(nameof(Name), IsUnique = true)]
public class Tenant
{
    [Column("id")]
    public Guid Id { get; set; }

    [Column("name")]
    [MaxLength(80)]
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Column("status")]
    public Status Status { get; set; } = Status.DRAFT;
}
